services.name: Piano lesson at home, 45 min
services.story: The main story: a $75 45-minute piano lesson at home for Noah with Daniel. A card is saved for the $40 late-cancel and no-show fee, and charged $75 when Daniel texts DONE.

services.name: Trial lesson at home
services.story: A $45 trial lesson at home, 30 minutes, paid in full when booking. A late cancel or nobody home: the $45 may be kept, with Sam's OK.

services_shape: private lessons with a chosen teacher; the instrument picks who can teach it, and the length (30 or 45 minutes, 60 for audition prep) sets the price
questions_before_times: the instrument (or voice), and the length: 30 or 45 minutes (60 for audition prep)
the level: never played, beginner, or plays already
at the studio, at home or online
a trial lesson, a single lesson, or weekly lessons
safety_stop: a student hurt or very unwell at a lesson: hard to breathe, a fall, an allergy reaction
first_steps: none: a trial lesson is booked as its own lesson, never as a step before another
license: none found for private music lessons or piano tuning: identity is checked, the business gives its registration, and a person on Rosie's team checks the state's site within 1 business day
staff_skills: each teacher's instruments and the ages they teach; only teachers of an instrument are offered for it (only Elena teaches violin at the example studio)
messages_never: a student's age, school, learning, health or hearing notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page; texts name a student by first name only
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
